description: Propose a remove-from-service decision, requiring human approval, when an asset has a safety-critical fault and at least one other related event in the preceding 60 days (a repeat, not a first-time, safety-critical occurrence). This is the rule that drives the A-142 hold-from-service decision in the primary demo storyline.

parameters.rationale: Repeat safety-critical fault on a braking or other safety-relevant component; asset must not return to service without explicit human sign-off.

description: Propose a remove-from-service decision, requiring human approval, when an inspector flags a possible structural defect even without confirmed measurement evidence. The evidence-quality caveat must be preserved on the proposed decision rather than stripped out, since this decision rests on thin evidence by the inspector's own account.

parameters.rationale: Inspector-flagged possible structural defect on the overhead guard, explicitly unconfirmed and without measurement or photo evidence; route to a human decision-maker rather than auto-executing.

parameters.reason: High-risk decision proposal rests on unconfirmed, unmeasured evidence.
